items.quote: Several respondents noted that Jomon Brenari drove mapping interdependencies across agencies for the whole division.
Several respondents noted that Jomon Brenari assisted with engagement with industry stakeholders.
Several respondents noted that Jomon took ownership of the reduction of waiting times at the licensing counter and steered it to completion.
Jomon led negotiations with contractors on the service agreement across the department.
He drove delivery under pressure through a demanding year-end peak for the whole division.
Several respondents noted that Jomon Brenari spearheaded the overnight response when the haze situation escalated at the national level.
Direct reports said that Jomon set the direction for customer feedback improvements at service centres across the public service.
Jomon championed media interviews and press conferences and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Jomon spearheaded an ethics review of conflict-of-interest declarations at the national level.
He led teamwork across departments on the annual review across the department.
